CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW lwql_snap.traces
SQL SECURITY INVOKER
AS SELECT
  src.`TenantId` AS `TenantId`,
  src.`TraceId` AS `TraceId`,
  src.`TraceName` AS `TraceName`,
  src.`OccurredAt` AS `OccurredAt`,
  src.`UpdatedAt` AS `UpdatedAt`,
  src.`TotalDurationMs` AS `TotalDurationMs`,
  src.`TimeToFirstTokenMs` AS `TimeToFirstTokenMs`,
  src.`TimeToLastTokenMs` AS `TimeToLastTokenMs`,
  src.`TokensPerSecond` AS `TokensPerSecond`,
  src.`SpanCount` AS `SpanCount`,
  src.`ContainsErrorStatus` AS `ContainsErrorStatus`,
  src.`ContainsOKStatus` AS `ContainsOKStatus`,
  src.`Models` AS `Models`,
  src.`TotalCost` AS `TotalCost`,
  src.`TokensEstimated` AS `TokensEstimated`,
  src.`TotalPromptTokenCount` AS `TotalPromptTokenCount`,
  src.`TotalCompletionTokenCount` AS `TotalCompletionTokenCount`,
  src.`SatisfactionScore` AS `SatisfactionScore`,
  src.`TopicId` AS `TopicId`,
  src.`SubTopicId` AS `SubTopicId`,
  src.`ContainsPrompt` AS `ContainsPrompt`,
  src.`SelectedPromptId` AS `SelectedPromptId`,
  src.`LastUsedPromptId` AS `LastUsedPromptId`,
  src.`LastUsedPromptVersionId` AS `LastUsedPromptVersionId`,
  src.`LastUsedPromptVersionNumber` AS `LastUsedPromptVersionNumber`,
  src.`SourceType` AS `SourceType`,
  mapFilter((k, v) -> k NOT IN ('ai.prompt', 'ai.prompt.messages', 'ai.response', 'ai.response.object', 'ai.response.text', 'ai.toolCall', 'ai.toolCall.args', 'gen_ai.completion', 'gen_ai.input.messages', 'gen_ai.output.messages', 'gen_ai.prompt', 'gen_ai.response.choices', 'gen_ai.response.finish_reasons', 'gen_ai.system_instructions', 'gen_ai.tool.call.arguments', 'gen_ai.tool.call.result', 'input', 'input.value', 'langwatch.input', 'langwatch.output', 'llm.input_messages', 'llm.output_messages', 'output', 'output.value', 'raw_input', 'traceloop.entity.input', 'traceloop.entity.output') AND NOT arrayExists(p -> startsWith(k, p), ['ai.prompt.', 'ai.prompt.messages.', 'ai.response.', 'ai.response.object.', 'ai.response.text.', 'ai.toolCall.', 'ai.toolCall.args.', 'gen_ai.completion.', 'gen_ai.input.messages.', 'gen_ai.output.messages.', 'gen_ai.prompt.', 'gen_ai.response.choices.', 'gen_ai.response.finish_reasons.', 'gen_ai.system_instructions.', 'gen_ai.tool.call.arguments.', 'gen_ai.tool.call.result.', 'input.', 'input.value.', 'langwatch.input.', 'langwatch.output.', 'llm.input_messages.', 'llm.output_messages.', 'output.', 'output.value.', 'raw_input.', 'traceloop.entity.input.', 'traceloop.entity.output.']), src.`Attributes`) AS `Attributes`,
  src.`ComputedInput` AS `CapturedInput`,
  src.`ComputedOutput` AS `CapturedOutput`
FROM langwatch.trace_summaries AS src FINAL
